shortDescription: Modus Therapeutics Holding AB (publ) OMXSTO:MODTX:Source text:Further company coverage:

children: SAID ON WEDNESDAY VOLUNTARILY DECIDED, AS A PRECAUTIONARY MEASURE, TO TEMPORARILY PAUSE ENROLLMENT IN PART 2 OF THE ONGOING PHASE IIA STUDY OF SEVUPARIN WITHIN THE CO'S PROGRAM IN CKD WITH ANEMIA
THE DECISION WAS MADE AFTER A SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENT IN A PATIENT TREATED WITH SEVUPARIN WAS REPORTED
THE PAUSE IS NOT THE RESULT OF A REGULATORY DECISION
PRELIMINARY ASSESSMENT IS THAT THE PAUSE WILL SHIFT THE PROOF-OF-CONCEPT READOUT FROM AROUND THE TURN OF THE YEAR 2026/2027 TO Q1 2027
ANY EFFECTS OF PAUSE ON COSTS, TIMELINE TO BE REFLECTED IN UPDATED ASSESSMENT OF CO'S FINANCING THAT MODUS INTENDS TO PRESENT IN Q3 INTERIM REPORT ON NOVEMBER 24, 2026

title: Modus Therapeutics Temporarily Pauses Enrollment In Phase IIa Study Of Sevuparin In CKD With Anemia
